data.title: Beekman Group Portfolio Company Convenient Brands Divests IntelliPay, a Leader in Omnichannel, Fee-Based Payment Processing Solutions for Government, Education, and Other Diversified End Markets
data.description: A company called Convenient Brands, Inc. based in Draper, Utah, disclosed that they have finalized the transaction involving the sale of Convenient Payments, LLC, known as IntelliPay. IntelliPay is renowned for its top-notch payment processing and management software utilized by various sectors including government entities, educational facilities, healthcare providers, and merchants. The buyer of IntelliPay is Priority Commerce. This software guarantees security with its scalability and compliance with PCI DSS standards.

data.title: CLEAResult Québec Acquires GMI, Strengthening Its Presence in Québec's Energy Efficiency Market
data.description: Toronto-based CLEAResult Québec, a subsidiary of CLEAResult Canada, recently revealed its acquisition of Groupe Marketing International, Inc. (GMI), a customer care and operations partner situated in Québec. With extensive expertise in aiding energy efficiency programs in the province, GMI has been working closely with CLEAResult since the establishment of CLEAResult Québec in 2025. This move underscores CLEAResult's position as Canada's leading provider of energy efficiency, energy transition, and energy sustainability services.

data.title: Fortell Sets New Hearing Aid Performance Records in Independent Testing
data.description: Fortell, based in New York, revealed that its Fortell AI Hearing Aids have achieved remarkable scores in testing conducted by the independent laboratory, HearAdvisor. The aids received the highest overall SoundScore of 6.0 and a speech-in-noise score of 6.4, surpassing the previous record of 4.5. This makes the Fortell AI Hearing Aids the top-performing model of 2026 according to HearAdvisor's standardized evaluation process.
